title: 第3章 废物五灵根
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“是老夫想差了，这位小姐这边请。”

    金长老将微生璃月往测灵石方向引，天知道刚才他因为面前这位小姐的话稍稍不满，神识都还未曾动作，这姑娘身旁那几尊杀神就齐齐朝他望来，属于强者的威压立马落到身上。

    那种深入神魂深处的压迫感让他意识到面前这几个人不好惹，就像刚刚这位小姐说的，修仙修的不仅仅是实力，还有人情世故。

    他最懂的就是人情世故，至于计较？他打得过人家周围那几个吗，就计较。

    测灵石前，众人紧张地围观着这位从一出现就吸引所有人目光的大小姐，她行事如此嚣张，想必定是天赋卓绝，才会如此有底气。

    然而测灵石光柱亮起的那一刻，众人神色呆滞……

    五种颜色，废物五灵根？

    这是逗他们玩呢？

    刚刚这人的所作所为，明显是万中无一的天才作为，人家甚至连叶道友的极品变异雷灵根都看不上，结果是个废物五灵根。

    看到这个结果，信心满满的微生璃月愣住了。

    剧情里，原主不是木火双灵根吗？

    怎么到了她这里就成了五灵根，逗她呢？

    “统子，这是怎么回事？”

    微生璃月以为自己装了个大的，没想到是拉了坨大的。

    “抱歉抱歉，宿主我忘记跟你说了，我是直接把你的身体复活带到这个世界，你的灵根自然也以你自己的天赋为主。”装逼系统有些心虚，刚绑定宿主不久，它忘记先替宿主测一测灵根了。

    现在再测，呃，它家宿主好像不止五灵根呢。

    “亲爱的宿主，告诉你个不好的消息，其实你的灵根不止五个，你是全系灵根呢？”

    工作失误的系统此时格外好说话，它不明白，以自己的系统程序，选择绑定的宿主那肯定是万中无一的天才。

    要不然它以后给宿主的那些灵丹妙药怎么帮宿主快速升级，然后装逼闪瞎世人。

    明明系统程序里，《太荒混沌诀》自己选中了宿主，这可是非绝世天才不选的神级功法。

    现在这个情况又是怎么回事，难不成宿主的灵根其实不一般？可它也没扫出任何问题啊。
content_en:
"I'm thinking of something wrong. I'll invite this young lady here."

Elder Jin guided Wei Sheng Liyue towards the direction of the spirit-testing stone. Who knows, he was a little dissatisfied just now because of the words of the young lady in front of him. Before his consciousness could move, the killing gods beside the young lady all looked at him, and the pressure of a strong man immediately fell on them.

The oppressive feeling that penetrated deep into his soul made him realize that these people in front of him were not to be trifled with. Just like what the young lady said just now, cultivating immortality is not just about strength, but also about worldliness.

What he knows best is the world's ways of doing things. As for care?Whether he can beat the few around him is a matter of care.

In front of the spirit-testing stone, everyone nervously watched the eldest lady who had attracted everyone's attention from the moment she appeared. She acted so arrogantly, so she must have great talent to be so confident.

However, the moment the light pillar of the spirit-detecting stone lit up, everyone looked dull...

Five colors, five spiritual roots of waste?

Are you kidding them?

What this man did just now was obviously an act of genius that was unique in a million. He didn't even look down on Daoist Ye's top-quality mutated thunder spirit root, but it turned out to be a useless five spirit root.

Seeing this result, the confident Weisheng Liyue was stunned.

In the plot, doesn’t the original owner have the twin spiritual roots of wood and fire?

Why did he become the Five Spiritual Roots when he arrived at her place? Are you teasing her?

"Tongzi, what's going on?"

Weisheng Liyue thought she was pretending to be a big one, but she didn't expect that she had a big one.

"I'm sorry, host, I forgot to tell you. I directly resurrected your body and brought it to this world. Your spiritual roots are naturally based on your own talents." The pretentious system was a little guilty. Not long after it was bound to the host, it forgot to test the host's spiritual roots first.

Now test again, eh, it seems that its host has more than five spiritual roots.

"Dear host, I have bad news for you. In fact, you have more than five spiritual roots. Do you have all spiritual roots?"

The system that failed in its work is particularly easy to talk to at this time. It does not understand that with its own system program, it must be a unique genius to choose a host to bind to.

Otherwise, how can the panacea it gives to the host in the future help the host to upgrade quickly, and then blind the world with its pretense.

Obviously, in the system program, "Taihuang Chaos Art" has chosen its host. This is a god-level technique that only a peerless genius would not choose.

What is going on with this situation now? Is it possible that the host's spiritual roots are actually unusual?But it didn't detect any problems.
